$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Compact Before the Cache Expires settings: the acpmux daemon's timer that compacts an idle Claude chat while its prompt cache is still warm (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/hub/cache_compact.rs). The daemon reads these keys from the settings file each time it arms the timer and checks this file's defaults and ranges in its tests; gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: agentCache
lists.note: Settings > General > Prompt Cache (Leo, 2026-11-03: "idk if we maybe also wanna be showing that/opt-in autocompact around that 5min mark"; "we ought to make these all accessibly toggle-able ofc"). On by default since 2026-11-24 (Leo: "we need to be compacting arguably BEFORE cache expires...", "this can be toggled but... this as a default seems decent."): a warm compaction costs about 40% of the cold rewrite of the whole context it saves.

rows.name: cacheCompactEnabled
rows.note: On: an idle Claude chat whose context is over agents.cacheCompact.minContextPercent runs /compact about 30 s before its prompt cache expires (once per idle stretch; never mid-turn, with a prompt queued, or while someone types). On by default; off: acpmux arms no timer.

help.text: Compacts an idle Claude chat while its cache is warm, so the next message costs less.

rows.name: cacheCompactMinContext
rows.note: The share of the context window (percent) a chat must be using before the timer compacts it.

help.text: Chats using less of their context window than this are left as they are.
